title: static-ads-builder recipe.json (mode winning_recipe)
description: The decomposition of the winning ad (named by scripts/perf.py or given by the founder). scripts/recipe_variants.py seed fills the measured fields from the ad as it ran; the model writes the judgement fields (hook type, layout zones, palette roles). scripts/recipe_variants.py build turns it and a hooks.json into ads.json variants that keep the structure and change one variable each.

ad_name.description: The winner as named in Ads Manager.

picked_by.description: perf: first winner of ads-performance-YYYYMMDD.json. manual: the founder named it.

why.description: The metric that made it the winner, as read in the perf file, or the founder's reason.

perf_file.description: ads-performance-YYYYMMDD.json it was read from, relative to this file.

spec.description: ads.json of the run that produced the winner, relative to this file. Its meta, sources and brand carry over to the variants.

angle.description: Angle slug (assets/ad-library.md section 1). Kept by every variant.

hook_type.description: Headline structure of the winner (assets/ad-library.md section 2). New hooks keep it.

band.description: short: headline up to 8 words. medium: 9 to 14. long: 15 and more.

accent_role.description: Where the accent colour sits on the winner (emphasis word, button, a band).

colors.description: brand.json colours seen on the render, when worth naming.

on_ad.description: Button text on the creative, empty when there was none.

meta.description: Meta call-to-action type of the winner.

control.description: The winning ad as an ads.json ad object (validated against assets/ads.schema.json $defs/ad). Every variant is a copy of it with one variable changed.
